data.title: Pick your model and *effort*
data.subtitle: Next to the send button. On your phone: top of the screen.
steps: Click the **model name** next to the send button
Pick a model, or **More models**. Not sure? **Opus 5.5**
**Effort**: Low, Medium, High, Extra high, Max. Leave it on **Default**
Free plan: **Sonnet** and **Haiku**. The change applies from the next answer
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. Higher effort thinks longer and uses more of your limit. In the apps the default is Medium.
